title: Expensive pricing/subscription scheme
body:
I've had enough of subscription schemes which over time adds up to an insane total cost of ownership when compared to apps and software far more complex and useful.

Using this app over - let's say two years, adds up to over $250. But then you'd probably want to continue using it? Right?

Even the lifetime subscription price is insane when compared to pro-level productivity apps, calendars etc.

Piece of advice to the developer:
Cut the price by 70-90% and instead focus on growing your customer base. I think you have a great product going here and with all the fellow ADHD-ers out there, I'm sure you'll earn the money you so clearly deserve - maybe even sooner rather than later.
author: Steinar.pop
